top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs ligand-controlled Pd-catalysed C-N coupling (Buchwald, Hartwig) with base editing (Liu). The coupling is the one result whose adoption I can verify directly in the synthetic literature: a mechanistically defined, general method that made aryl amines routine in medicinal and process chemistry, with Kosugi's stoichiometric tin-amide work as precursor rather than co-discovery. Base editing is designed chemistry on a single nucleobase (engineered deaminase, evolved adenine deaminase acting on DNA), distinct from the cleavage rewarded in 2020. Each part stands alone. If the pairing is not accepted I would hold Liu alone (P005) before trading either part for a weaker partner.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no tie to any laureate in the slate. Buchwald and Hartwig work in my own field of synthetic methodology, a scientific closeness that I disclose.
